bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs, springboard/render/src/ui.rs, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs, springboard/ui/src/panels.rs, springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_object.rs, springboard/sdk/src/color_list.rs
summary: Semantic colours, a colour panel, colour spaces and conversions, colour lists, PNG/JPEG decoding, an NSImage-style object with representations, template flag and resizable caps, procedural symbol glyphs, a software 2D Surface and CUPS printing exist. There is no NSImage drawing in the kit, no colour picker that uses colour lists, and no print sheet.

features.feature: Images and PDF: image objects and representations
features.note: ImageObject (sdk/src/image_object.rs) holds bitmap and vector representations, picks the best one for a target size and scale, keeps a point size, a template flag and cap insets, computes nine-slice layouts and reads the size of encoded bytes; image_source::representation encodes a bitmap (JPEG compression factor, transparent pixels flattened for JPEG). Host tests only; not yet used by the kit's image widgets or the shell. No representation classes per codec (no TIFF/GIF/WebP/HEIC rep), no template tint when drawn, no named image catalogue; verify on Midget for parity. built on parity/team-k-appkit-graphics-printing; not yet verified on Midget.
fixed set of procedural line glyphs (59), one weight, no hierarchical or palette rendering (docs/bifrost-ui.md)

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (open a PDF for pages, size and a rasterised page; writer); springboard/ui/src/pdfpage.rs (page boxes, rotation, aspect-fit); springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/mod.rs
features.note: Apps can open a PDF to read its page count, page sizes and rasterised pages through the SDK, and the page geometry is tested in pdfpage. Gap: text extraction and annotation editing stay in the PDF app, and the Books engine keeps its own parser.

features.feature: Images and PDF: file and app icons
features.note: procedural folder icon only; no per-file-type icon set

features.feature: Drawing: 2D drawing context and basic shapes
features.apple: NSGraphicsContext, NSRectFill, NSBezierPath fill/stroke of rects and rounded rects
features.note: software Surface with rect, rounded rect, squircle masks and damage tracking; no general path object, no clipping paths, no affine transform stack for apps

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/drawing_model.rs (BezierPath, Gradient, ShadowStyle, PageLayout), springboard/render/src/bezier.rs, springboard/render/src/gradient.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/layer_style.rs (Shadow, used by style.rs); wired: springboard/ui/src/layer_style.rs (Shadow::radius) via springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/style.rs (blur_taps, paint_with_blur)
features.note: BezierPath construction, bounds, winding-rule containment, fills, strokes and clipping (pixel-exact on the graphics context), Gradient stops and offsets, ShadowStyle extent and PageLayout pagination are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs (drawing module). Gaps: dash and cap/join styles are stored but not rendered; image representations, colour space lists and the modal print run remain missing; wired into the UI in waves 5 and 6, not yet verified on Midget.
glass hook and light/dark cross-fade exist; Spotlight blur still missing per CLAUDE.md
retained views with damage rects; not the NSView draw cycle or NSCell model

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/gpu_layer.rs (drawable layer for apps, from bifrost_ui::drawable_layer); springboard/ui/src/drawable_layer.rs (DrawableLayer: drawables, present, recycle); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs, docs/gpu-first.md
features.note: Apps get a drawable layer that hands presented frames to the shell and converts them to images, tested inline in the drawable_layer model. Gap: apps have no GPU command or shader API, and the presenter that scans frames out stays in the shell.

features.apple: NSColor named colours, systemRed..systemGray, labelColor, controlAccentColor
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/ui.rs (mod system), docs/bifrost-ui.md section NSColor semantic colours
features.note: most named colours as light/dark Pairs; windowFrameColor, findHighlightColor and shadowColor added (WINDOW_FRAME, FIND_HIGHLIGHT, SHADOW; findHighlight values are an approximation to confirm on Midget); user accent colour not wired; remaining NSColor names missing built on parity/team-k-appkit-graphics-printing; not yet verified on Midget.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. RGB plus alpha model with change callback; no colour well control, no picker modes (wheel, sliders, palettes, crayons)

Colour spaces and conversions are in graphics_color (bifrost_render::cg::color, ICC profiles for apps). ColorList and ColorLists add NSColorList: ordered named colours with a registry by name. Host tests only; no colour well or picker that uses the lists, and no eyedropper; verify on Midget for parity. built on parity/team-k-appkit-graphics-printing; not yet verified on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/print.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (Job, Layout, paper and scale) over springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/ui/src/print_pages.rs (PdfContext, PrintableView, paginate)
features.note: paper, orientation, margins, copies, page range, scaling_factor and job_disposition (spool, save, preview); PrintOperation::print_operation(view) paginates a PrintableView (knows_page_range, rect_for_page, or tiles) and draws it into a PDF through PdfContext (fills, paths, text, images); pdf_operation(view, rect, path); run_modal with shows_print_panel and did_run; submits via IPP or saves the PDF. Host tests only: pages are drawn when the operation is made, no rich text or font embedding (Helvetica only), no clipping or transforms beyond the page tile; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Printing: print panel, page layout, accessory views
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/print_panel.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (sheet rows: printer, paper, orientation, scale, copies); accessory views not done, springboard/ui/src/print_pages.rs
features.note: print_panel.rs adds PanelOptions (showsCopies, page range, paper size, orientation, scaling, preview, print selection) whose apply() writes a PanelRequest into the print info and refuses hidden controls, and PageSetup (paper, orientation, margins, scale) that round-trips with the print info; plug-in panels (accessory controllers) are keyed models. The shell sheet builds its PrintInfo through the defaults; the scale row and a shell-drawn page layout panel are not wired; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/cups.rs, springboard/ui/src/printer_caps.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (printers and targets) over springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/ui/src/printer_caps.rs (imageable_rect)
features.note: cups::Client::printers() lists queues; get_printer_attributes() reads capabilities (printer_caps.rs: PWG paper list with PPD names, duplex, colour modes, default media, status and reasons, Letter/A4 fallback, hardware margins from media-*-margin-supported); paper_size_in_points and imageable_rect(name) give paperSize(forPaperName:) and the printable rect; print panel not yet using them; deviceDescription and languageLevel missing; verify on Midget for parity.
